tools.name: chain_info
tools.description: Get Robinhood Chain network identity and live head: chain ID, RPC, explorer, native currency, latest block, gas price.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Get a block by number ('latest', 'earliest', a decimal height, or a hex height).

tools.name: gas_price
tools.description: Current gas price, with an EIP-1559 fee breakdown when the chain provides one.

tools.name: estimate_gas
tools.description: Estimate gas for a call without sending it.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Native ETH balance for an address.

tools.name: get_nonce
tools.description: Transaction count (nonce) for an address.

tools.name: is_contract
tools.description: Whether an address holds contract code, and how much.

tools.name: get_token_balance
tools.description: ERC-20 balance for an address. Accepts a known symbol (e.g. USDG) or a token address.

tools.name: list_token_holdings
tools.description: All token balances held by an address, via the explorer index. Mainnet only.

tools.name: read_contract
tools.description: Call a read-only contract function using a human-readable signature, e.g. 'function balanceOf(address) view returns (uint256)'.

signature.description: Full function signature, e.g. 'function symbol() view returns (string)'

tools.name: raw_call
tools.description: Low-level eth_call with hand-built calldata. Returns raw returndata, and identifies the revert selector when the call reverts — useful for probing whether a function exists on a Diamond.

tools.name: build_transaction
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction for external signing. This server never holds keys and cannot broadcast.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Get a transaction by hash.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Get a transaction receipt, including status and logs.

tools.name: address_transactions
tools.description: Recent transactions for an address, via the explorer index. Mainnet only.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Query event logs by address and/or topics.

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: List ERC-20 tokens on Robinhood Chain, most-held first, via the explorer index. Mainnet only.

limit.description: Max tokens to return (page size is 50)

tools.name: known_assets
tools.description: Curated Robinhood Chain assets with verified metadata, including which support EIP-3009 / EIP-2612.

tools.name: token_info
tools.description: Detailed token info from the explorer: supply, holders, market data. Mainnet only.

tools.name: chain_stats
tools.description: Explorer-level chain statistics: block time, gas prices, total transactions, market data. Mainnet only.

tools.name: probe_token_capabilities
tools.description: Detect whether a token supports EIP-3009 (gasless transferWithAuthorization) and EIP-2612 (permit). Works correctly on EIP-2535 Diamonds, where scanning proxy bytecode reports false negatives.

tools.name: usdg_info
tools.description: USDG (Global Dollar) details: address, decimals, supply, and its verified EIP-712 domain.

tools.name: check_authorization
tools.description: Check whether an EIP-3009 authorization nonce has already been used. EIP-3009 nonces are random bytes32, not sequential.

authorizer.description: The address that signed the authorization

tools.name: build_transfer_authorization
tools.description: Build the EIP-712 payload for a gasless EIP-3009 transfer, ready for external signing. Returns the typed-data struct — this server never signs.

amount.description: Human amount, e.g. '1.5' — converted using token decimals

tools.name: arb_block_number
tools.description: L2 block number from the ArbSys precompile. This is the value eth_blockNumber returns — distinct from the block.number a contract observes.

tools.name: block_number_context
tools.description: Explain the three different 'block numbers' on this chain: the L2 height from eth_blockNumber, the L1 height a contract sees via block.number, and ArbSys.arbBlockNumber(). Getting these confused is the most common Orbit integration bug.

tools.name: arb_chain_id
tools.description: Chain ID reported by the ArbSys precompile, cross-checked against eth_chainId.

tools.name: arbos_version
tools.description: ArbOS version running on this chain.

tools.name: arb_gas_prices
tools.description: Full gas price breakdown from ArbGasInfo: per-L2-tx, per-L1-calldata-byte, per storage allocation, and the base fee components.

tools.name: arb_l1_base_fee
tools.description: Current L1 base fee estimate used for data-availability pricing.

tools.name: arb_min_gas_price
tools.description: Minimum gas price (floor) enforced by the chain.

tools.name: arb_gas_accounting
tools.description: Speed limit, gas pool size, and max transaction gas from ArbGasInfo.

tools.name: arb_l1_pricing
tools.description: L1 pricing internals: surplus, per-batch gas charge, and the amortized cost cap.

tools.name: estimate_l1_component
tools.description: Estimate the L1 data-availability component of a transaction's cost via the NodeInterface precompile — the part a plain eth_estimateGas does not show.

tools.name: precompile_status
tools.description: Which Arbitrum precompiles are actually usable on this chain. Probes each with a real call rather than trusting that a canonical address implies a working precompile.

tools.name: build_l2_to_l1_withdrawal
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED ArbSys.withdrawEth call to start an L2->L1 ETH withdrawal. Returns calldata only; this server never signs. Note the multi-day challenge period before the L1 claim can be executed.

tools.name: keccak_hash
tools.description: keccak256 of a UTF-8 string or hex bytes.

tools.name: function_selector
tools.description: Compute the 4-byte selector for a function signature, e.g. 'transfer(address,uint256)'.

tools.name: event_topic
tools.description: Compute the topic0 hash for an event signature, e.g. 'Transfer(address,address,uint256)'.

tools.name: checksum_address
tools.description: Validate an address and return its EIP-55 checksummed form.

tools.name: encode_abi
tools.description: ABI-encode values against a parameter signature, e.g. params='address,uint256'.

tools.name: decode_abi
tools.description: ABI-decode a hex blob against a parameter signature.

tools.name: decode_calldata
tools.description: Decode calldata against a known function signature, splitting selector from arguments.

tools.name: to_wei
tools.description: Convert a decimal amount to base units without floating-point rounding.

tools.name: from_wei
tools.description: Convert base units to a decimal amount.

tools.name: hex_convert
tools.description: Convert between hex, decimal, and UTF-8 string.

tools.name: random_nonce
tools.description: Generate a random 32-byte nonce, suitable for an EIP-3009 authorization. EIP-3009 nonces are random, not sequential.

tools.name: token_metadata
tools.description: Read name, symbol, decimals and total supply directly from a token contract. Tolerates tokens that return bytes32 instead of string.

tools.name: token_allowance
tools.description: ERC-20 allowance an owner has granted a spender.

tools.name: multi_token_balance
tools.description: Read one address's balance across several tokens in a single Multicall3 round-trip.

tools.name: build_token_transfer
tools.description: Build UNSIGNED calldata for an ERC-20 transfer. Amount is parsed against the token's real decimals; over-precise amounts are refused rather than truncated.

tools.name: build_token_approve
tools.description: Build UNSIGNED calldata for an ERC-20 approve. Set unlimited=true for the max-uint256 allowance.

tools.name: decode_transfer_log
tools.description: Decode an ERC-20 Transfer event log into from/to/value.

topics.description: Log topics; topic0 must be the Transfer hash

tools.name: token_transfer_history
tools.description: ERC-20 transfer events involving an address, read from chain logs rather than the explorer, so it works on any network.

tools.name: nft_owner
tools.description: ERC-721 ownerOf for a token ID.

tools.name: nft_token_uri
tools.description: ERC-721 tokenURI, with inline data: URIs decoded when present.

tools.name: nft_balance
tools.description: ERC-721 balanceOf — how many NFTs from a collection an address holds.

tools.name: nft_collection_info
tools.description: ERC-721 collection name, symbol, and total supply where exposed.

tools.name: erc1155_balance
tools.description: ERC-1155 balanceOf for an (account, id) pair.

tools.name: detect_token_standard
tools.description: Detect whether a contract is ERC-20, ERC-721, or ERC-1155, using ERC-165 supportsInterface with an ERC-20 fallback.

tools.name: address_nfts
tools.description: NFTs held by an address, via the explorer index. Mainnet only.

tools.name: verify_authorization_signature
tools.description: Verify an EIP-3009 signature offline: does it recover to the claimed signer, for this exact token and chain? Catches wrong-domain and cross-chain-replay signatures before they cost gas.

tools.name: build_receive_authorization
tools.description: Build the EIP-712 payload for receiveWithAuthorization. Unlike transferWithAuthorization, only the payee may submit it — which closes the front-running window where anyone can relay a valid authorization.

tools.name: build_cancel_authorization
tools.description: Build the EIP-712 payload to cancel an unused EIP-3009 authorization before it can be redeemed.

tools.name: build_permit
tools.description: Build an EIP-2612 permit payload (gasless approval). Requires the token's current nonce, which is read on-chain.

tools.name: build_transfer_authorization_calldata
tools.description: Assemble the final transferWithAuthorization CALLDATA from a signed authorization, ready for a relayer to submit.

tools.name: list_eip3009_assets
tools.description: Assets on this chain known to support EIP-3009, and therefore usable for gasless, relayer-submitted payments.

tools.name: authorization_digest
tools.description: Compute the EIP-712 digest a wallet will be asked to sign for a given authorization, without signing it.

tools.name: verify_domain_separator
tools.description: Recompute a token's EIP-712 DOMAIN_SEPARATOR from its stored domain and compare it against the live contract. A mismatch means the contract was upgraded and stored signatures would be rejected.

tools.name: address_info
tools.description: Explorer summary for an address: balance, contract status, verification, transaction count.

tools.name: address_token_transfers
tools.description: Token transfers involving an address, from the explorer index.

tools.name: address_internal_transactions
tools.description: Internal transactions (contract-initiated value transfers) for an address.

tools.name: contract_source
tools.description: Verified source code and ABI for a contract, if the explorer has it.

tools.name: contract_abi
tools.description: Fetch just the ABI of a verified contract — feed it to read_contract to call methods without knowing signatures in advance.

tools.name: explorer_search
tools.description: Search the explorer for an address, token, transaction, or block.

tools.name: token_holders
tools.description: Largest holders of a token, from the explorer index.

tools.name: token_transfers
tools.description: Recent transfers of a specific token.

tools.name: latest_blocks
tools.description: Most recent blocks with transaction counts and gas usage.

tools.name: block_transactions
tools.description: All transactions in a given block, from the explorer index.

tools.name: verified_contracts
tools.description: Contracts with verified source on this chain — a quick map of what is actually deployed and public.

tools.name: x402_network_id
tools.description: The CAIP-2 network identifier for this chain, as x402 payloads must express it.

tools.name: x402_build_payment_requirements
tools.description: Build the paymentRequirements object a resource server returns in its HTTP 402 response.

tools.name: x402_build_payment_payload
tools.description: Assemble the x402 paymentPayload from a signed EIP-3009 authorization, ready to send in the X-PAYMENT header.

tools.name: x402_check_facilitator
tools.description: Query an x402 facilitator's /supported endpoint and report whether it can settle for this chain. Defaults to the hosted facilitator, which does not support Robinhood Chain.

tools.name: x402_decode_payment_header
tools.description: Decode a base64 X-PAYMENT header into its payload, and sanity-check it against this chain.

tools.name: verify_stock_token
tools.description: Determine whether a contract is a GENUINE Robinhood Stock Token or a ticker-squatting copy. The explorer lists multiple contracts per ticker and Robinhood publishes no registry to check against; this probes uiMultiplier(), which only the real tokens implement.

token.description: Contract address, or a ticker to search for

tools.name: stock_token_info
tools.description: Full state of a Robinhood Stock Token: metadata, the corporate-action multiplier, raw vs multiplier-adjusted supply, and every pause flag.

tools.name: stock_balance
tools.description: Balance of a Stock Token, reported BOTH raw and multiplier-adjusted. After any corporate action these differ, and the adjusted figure is the one representing economic exposure — reading balanceOf alone is the standard integration bug.

tools.name: check_corporate_action
tools.description: Check for a scheduled dividend or split on a Stock Token: the pending multiplier, when it takes effect, and how it will change holdings. Balances will not move — the multiplier does.

tools.name: check_address_blocked
tools.description: Check whether an address is blocked by the Stock Token AccessControlsRegistry. Blocked addresses cannot transfer, so a transfer that looks fine will revert.

tools.name: stock_token_registry
tools.description: The Stock Token AccessControlsRegistry: address, pause state, and its role. It also serves as the EIP-1967 beacon behind every Stock Token proxy.

tools.name: list_stock_tokens
tools.description: Find genuine Robinhood Stock Tokens by scanning explorer-indexed tokens and keeping only those implementing uiMultiplier(). There is no on-chain enumeration, so this is a scan, not a registry read.

tools.name: stock_token_terms
tools.description: Legal terms URI published on-chain by a Stock Token. These are securities issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited and are restricted in several jurisdictions.

tools.name: uniswap_contracts
tools.description: Uniswap v4 deployment addresses on Robinhood Chain, each checked for deployed code. Reports which periphery contracts are actually usable.

tools.name: uniswap_pool_id
tools.description: Compute the Uniswap v4 poolId from a PoolKey. Currencies are sorted automatically — an unsorted key yields a different, non-existent poolId, which is the usual reason a pool 'cannot be found'.

currency0.description: Token address, or 0x0 for native ETH

fee.description: Fee in hundredths of a bip (3000 = 0.30%)

tools.name: uniswap_pool_state
tools.description: Read a v4 pool's slot0 via StateView: current sqrt price, tick, protocol fee and LP fee. Accepts a poolId, or a PoolKey to derive one.

poolId.description: 32-byte poolId; omit to derive from a PoolKey

tools.name: uniswap_pool_liquidity
tools.description: Current in-range liquidity for a v4 pool.

tools.name: uniswap_fee_growth
tools.description: Global fee growth accumulators for a v4 pool — the basis for computing accrued LP fees.

tools.name: uniswap_find_pool
tools.description: Search for an initialised v4 pool across the standard fee tiers for a token pair, since v4 pools are not enumerable on-chain.

tools.name: price_feed_registry
tools.description: Configuration of the PriceFeedRegistry: feed decimals, default staleness bound, and L2 sequencer-uptime protection status.

tools.name: get_token_price
tools.description: USD price for a token via the PriceFeedRegistry, with the feed's age. Reverts with PriceFeedNotFound for unregistered tokens, including all Stock Tokens.

tools.name: get_stock_price
tools.description: USD price for a Robinhood Stock Token by ticker. Stock feeds are standalone Chainlink aggregators discoverable only by their description string — both 'Robinhood AAPL / USD' and 'RHAAPL / USD' conventions exist, and this checks for either.

ticker.description: Equity ticker, e.g. AAPL, TSLA, SPY

maxAgeSeconds.description: Flag the price stale beyond this age. Omit for no staleness verdict.

tools.name: read_price_feed
tools.description: Read any Chainlink AggregatorV3 feed directly: description, decimals, latest round, and age.

tools.name: list_price_feeds
tools.description: Discover Chainlink price feeds on this chain by reading each candidate's description(). Deduplicates proxies that front the same underlying aggregator.

tools.name: check_price_freshness
tools.description: Assess whether a feed's price is safe to use: age, round completeness, and the L2 sequencer-uptime caveat. Equity feeds are expected to be stale outside market hours.
